summary: Cline announced on October 19, 2026 that MiniMax M3.1 Flash is free in Cline, and on October 20 its live recommendation feed listed cline-free/minimax-m3.1-flash under free models. On October 23 the model was no longer in that free list, and the OpenRouter and OpenCode free periods for the same model ended October 22; Cline has not announced an end, so check the model selector before relying on it. Per Cline's docs, free model promotions rotate on a limited-time basis, need a Cline account, run up to a limited usage quota, and work only in the Cline IDE extension and CLI, not through the Cline API. Free model usage may be used to help improve model performance and quality. The quota size is not published. No end date is stated.
claim_steps: Install the Cline CLI (npm i -g cline) or the desktop app (https://cline.bot/desktop), and sign in with a Cline account.
In the Cline (usage-billing) provider, pick MiniMax M3.1 Flash tagged FREE in the model selector.
Use it in the IDE extension or CLI only; free usage is not available through the Cline API and stops at the free quota.
Free usage may be used to help improve model performance and quality.
